About Sugar Nails

Where Beauty Feels Natural

Sugar Nails is a warm nail destination in Clemson, SC, created for guests who love expressive style, thoughtful details, and gentle salon care.

Our team focuses on thoughtful nail care, modern styles, and a comfortable lounge atmosphere. From manicures and pedicures to polished nail designs, every visit is designed to feel fresh, refined, and beautifully personal.
